Group cases retain active alternative receivers and paired inclusion controls. Effect edits, tails, automation, missing-device tests and hardware return loss start from independently positive paths; absence or silence cannot prove exclusion.
checks.Freeze_context: Settings exclusion is scoped alongside the explicit frozen edit exceptions. Time-effect edits may differ on unfreeze rather than requiring a mismatch. Tail presentation/removal is separated from tail audio and file cleanup. Two Session cycles supply no rounded extent or guaranteed envelope difference. checks.Paste_context: Source state at paste time is distinct from copied source identity; single-track Session and listed Arrangement/group copy contexts do not imply a universal refusal table. Empty MIDI conversion and deleted-source availability are separate visible predicates. Clipboard representation, occupied destinations, partial deletion and Undo remain unknown.
checks.owners_and_hardware: Generic Arrangement/consolidation, export, routing/mixing, automation, clips/scenes/recording, project/media, external devices and Set structure retain their owners. Hardware real-time Freeze is a documented conditional mode requiring accepted functioning hardware, not evidence of an available route or numeric latency. Export cancellation or save cleanup is not borrowed.
checks.lifecycle: Boundary, automation, rates, transport, undo/redo, cancel, persistence/relocation, teardown, source/media/device loss, disk failure, malformed admitted inputs and recovery cases remain explicit ungraded investigations. Unsupported controls or independently unestablished encodings are unmet prerequisites rather than guessed mechanisms or passes.
